steps.name: 상태 표시줄 - B2:B5 를 고르면 평균·개수·합계, 누르면 최소·최대
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const b=document.querySelector('#sumBar'); const t1=b.textContent; b.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,50)); const t2=b.textContent; b.click(); return !b.hidden && t1.includes('합계 2,800') && t1.includes('평균 700') && t1.includes('개수 4') && t2.includes('최대 1,200') ? true : JSON.stringify({t1,t2})

steps.name: 자동 합계(Alt+=) - B6 에서 =SUM(B2:B5) 를 넣고 Enter → 2800

steps.name: 정렬 - B 열 내림차순(첫 줄 머리글 자동), 수식 칸은 범위 밖이라 그대로

steps.name: Ctrl+D - C2:C4 에서 첫 칸(C2) 을 아래로 · 편집 중 Ctrl+Enter 는 고른 범위 모두에
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, X=N.x, ed=X.ED(), sh=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0]; N.setInput(sh(),'C2','=B2*2'); X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:2,r2:3,c2:2}); ed.focus(); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'d',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const f3=sh().cells.C3&&sh().cells.C3.f, f4=sh().cells.C4&&sh().cells.C4.f; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:4,r2:3,c2:4}); X.startEdit('enter','확인'); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',ctrlKey:true,bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const c=sh().cells, v=(k)=>c[k]&&typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k]; return f3==='=B3*2' && f4==='=B4*2' && v('E2')==='확인' && v('E4')==='확인' ? true : JSON.stringify({f3,f4,E2:v('E2'),E4:v('E4')})

steps.name: 찾기·바꾸기 - '지점' → '센터' 모두 바꾸기(2칸), 실행 취소로 되돌림

steps.js: window.NexaSheetX.findBox(false); const q=(s)=>document.querySelector(s); q('#fbFind').value='부산'; q('#fbFind').dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); q('#fbFind').dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const nb=q('#nameBox').value, msg=q('#fbMsg').textContent; q('#fbClose').click(); return /^[AD]\d$/.test(nb) && /\d \/ 2/.test(msg) ? true : JSON.stringify({nb,msg})

steps.name: 행·열 숨기기 - 3행·C열을 숨기면 그 머리·칸이 화면에서 빠지고 저장, 숨기기 취소로 되돌림
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, sh=()=>window.NexaSheet.S.deck.sheets[0]; X.selectRange({r1:2,c1:0,r2:2,c2:0}); XX.hide('r',true); X.selectRange({r1:0,c1:2,r2:0,c2:2}); XX.hide('c',true); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const gone=!document.querySelector('#grid th[data-row="2"]') && !document.querySelector('#grid th[data-col="2"]'); const saved=JSON.stringify([sh().hiddenRows,sh().hiddenCols]); X.selectRange({r1:2,c1:0,r2:2,c2:0}); XX.hide('r',false); X.selectRange({r1:0,c1:2,r2:0,c2:2}); XX.hide('c',false); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const back=!!document.querySelector('#grid th[data-row="2"]') && !sh().hiddenRows && !sh().hiddenCols; return gone && saved==='[["3"],["C"]]' && back ? true : JSON.stringify({gone,saved,back})

steps.name: 필터 - 머리글 ▼ 에서 '부산' 빼기 → 그 행만 가림(탭 filter 에 저장 · 행 번호 파랑), 끄면 다시 보임
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S, sh=()=>S.deck.sheets[0]; X.selectCell(0,0); XX.filterToggle(); const b=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt[data-fc="0"]'), 3000); if(!b) return 'no button'; b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const pop=document.querySelector('.fltPop'); const lab=[...pop.querySelectorAll('label')].find(l=>l.textContent.includes('부산')); lab.querySelector('input').checked=false; pop.querySelector('[data-fa="ok"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const c=sh().cells, rowOf=Object.keys(c).find(k=>/^A\d+$/.test(k) && (typeof c[k]==='object'?c[k].v:c[k])==='부산'), r=+rowOf.slice(1)-1; const hidden=!document.querySelector(`#grid th[data-row="${r}"]`), saved=!!(sh().filter && (sh().filter.rows||[]).includes(String(r+1)) && sh().filter.cols && sh().filter.cols.A && !sh().filter.cols.A.vals.includes('부산')), notHiddenRows=!sh().hiddenRows, on=document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt.on'), blue=!!document.querySelector('#grid th.flr'); XX.filterToggle(); await new Promise(r2=>setTimeout(r2,80)); const back=!!document.querySelector(`#grid th[data-row="${r}"]`) && !document.querySelector('#fltLay .flt') && !sh().filter; return hidden && saved && notHiddenRows && on && blue && back ? true : JSON.stringify({hidden,saved,notHiddenRows,on:!!on,blue,back})

steps.name: 필터 - Ctrl+Shift+L 로 켜기 · 검색 '산' → 부산만 · 열 필터 해제 · 숫자 '보다 큼 600' · 하위 1 · 셀 색 기준 · 끄기
필터 - 검색 '서' 확인 → 서울만, 다시 검색 '부' + '현재 선택 영역을 필터에 추가' → 서울·부산 · 색 기준 정렬(초록 채우기 위로)
드롭다운 - F2:F5 에 목록(대기,진행,완료) → 칸 옆 ▼ 로 '진행' 고르기, 목록에 없는 값은 모서리 표시, 저장 형식 validations
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S; window.prompt=()=>'대기,진행,완료'; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:5,r2:4,c2:5}); XX.dvCreate(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); X.selectCell(2,5); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const b=document.querySelector('#dvBtn'); const vis=!b.hidden; b.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true})); const it=await until(()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('.menu button')].find(x=>x.textContent.trim()==='진행'), 3000); if(!it) return 'no item'; it.click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const sh=S.deck.sheets[0], v=(k)=>sh.cells[k]&&typeof sh.cells[k]==='object'?sh.cells[k].v:sh.cells[k]; window.NexaSheet.setInput(sh,'F4','없는값'); X.renderAll(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const marks=document.querySelectorAll('#dvLay i').length; return vis && v('F3')==='진행' && marks===1 && JSON.stringify(sh.validations)==='[{"range":"F2:F5","list":["대기","진행","완료"]}]' ? true : JSON.stringify({vis,F3:v('F3'),marks,dv:sh.validations})

steps.name: 조건부 서식 - B2:B5 '보다 큼 700' 빨강 채움 → 해당 칸 2개만 칠함, 지우면 사라짐
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, XX=window.NexaSheetX, S=window.NexaSheet.S; X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); XX.condDialog(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const dlg=document.querySelector('.cfDlg'); dlg.querySelector('[data-k="type"]').value='gt'; dlg.querySelector('[data-k="v1"]').value='700'; dlg.querySelector('[data-k="st"]').value='0'; dlg.querySelector('[data-fa="ok"]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120)); const red=()=>[...document.querySelectorAll('#grid td[data-c="1"]')].filter(td=>/255, 199, 206/.test(getComputedStyle(td).backgroundColor)).length; const n1=red(), saved=JSON.stringify(S.deck.sheets[0].conds); X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:4,c2:1}); XX.condClear(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); const n2=red(); return n1===2 && n2===0 && saved.includes('"type":"gt"') ? true : JSON.stringify({n1,n2,saved})

steps.name: 함수 자동 완성 - =sumi 치면 SUMIF·SUMIFS 목록, Tab 으로 SUMIF( 넣고 인수 안내
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(); X.selectCell(9,0); X.startEdit('enter','=sumi'); ed.setSelectionRange(5,5); ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const box=document.querySelector('#acBox'); const items=[...box.querySelectorAll('[data-ac]')].map(x=>x.dataset.ac); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Tab',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,60)); const v=ed.value, sig=box.querySelector('.sig') && box.querySelector('.sig').textContent; ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Escape',bubbles:true})); return items.join()==='SUMIF,SUMIFS' && v==='=SUMIF(' && sig && sig.includes('범위, 조건') ? true : JSON.stringify({items,v,sig})

steps.name: 동적 배열 - H2 에 =SORT(B2:B5) → 아래 칸으로 넘쳐 보인다(H3·H5 는 sp)
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); await put(1,7,'=SORT(B2:B5)'); const c=cells(); return c.H2.v===300 && c.H3 && c.H3.sp==='H2' && c.H5.v===1200 && ['1200','1,200'].includes(td(4,7)) ? true : JSON.stringify({H2:c.H2,H3:c.H3,H5:c.H5,td:td(4,7)})

steps.name: 넘칠 자리에 값을 쓰면 #SPILL!, 지우면 다시 넘친다
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); await put(3,7,'막음'); const a=cells().H2.v, h4=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(cells().H4)); await put(3,7,''); const c=cells(); return a==='#SPILL!' && (h4==='막음' || (h4.v==='막음' && !h4.sp)) && c.H2.v===300 && c.H4 && c.H4.sp==='H2' && c.H4.v===800 ? true : JSON.stringify({a,h4,H2:c.H2,H4:c.H4})

steps.name: 요약·사용자 함수 - K2 에 =GROUPBY(A2:A5,B2:B5,SUM) → 지역 4줄 + Total 2,800 으로 넘쳐 보이고, 이름 정의 세후=LAMBDA(x,x*0.9) 로 =세후(1000) → 900
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, ed=X.ED(), N=window.NexaSheet; const put=async(r,c,t)=>{ X.selectCell(r,c); ed.focus(); ed.value=t; ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); ed.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,150)); }; const cells=()=>N.S.deck.sheets[0].cells, td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector(`td[data-r="${r}"][data-c="${c}"]`).textContent.trim(); X.mutate(()=>{ N.S.deck.names={세후:'=LAMBDA(x,x*0.9)'}; }); await put(1,10,'=GROUPBY(A2:A5,B2:B5,SUM)'); await put(8,10,'=세후(1000)'); const c=cells(); return c.K2.v==='광주' && c.K6 && c.K6.sp==='K2' && c.K6.v==='Total' && c.L6.v===2800 && td(5,10)==='Total' && ['2800','2,800'].includes(td(5,11)) && c.K9.v===900 && td(8,10)==='900' ? true : JSON.stringify({K2:c.K2,K6:c.K6,L6:c.L6,K9:c.K9,t:[td(5,10),td(5,11),td(8,10)]})

steps.name: 요청 예시 칩 - 누르면 요청 칸에 문장(빈 칸이면 그대로, 글이 있으면 다음 줄), 보내지는 않는다
steps.js: const ta=document.querySelector('#reqText'), n0=document.querySelectorAll('#reqList .rq, #reqList [data-rid]').length; ta.value=''; const chips=[...document.querySelectorAll('#reqChips [data-chip]')]; if(chips.length<3) return 'chips='+chips.length; chips[0].click(); const a=ta.value; chips[1].click(); const b=ta.value; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,200)); const n1=document.querySelectorAll('#reqList .rq, #reqList [data-rid]').length; ta.value=''; ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); return a==='합계 행 추가' && b==='합계 행 추가'+String.fromCharCode(10)+'이 열은 % 형식으로' && n0===n1 && document.activeElement===ta ? true : JSON.stringify({a,b,n0,n1})

steps.name: 오류 칸 - K12 =1/0 에 마우스를 올리면 '#DIV/0! - 0 으로 나눴습니다', [오류 칸 원인 설명] 칩은 'K12 의 #DIV/0! 원인을…'

steps.name: 선택 상자 위치 - 좁은 열(D 45px)에 긴 글이 있어도 열이 넓어지지 않고, E2 를 고르면 상자가 E2 칸 위(표 너비 = 열 너비 합)
steps.js: const X=window.NexaSheet.x, sh=X.sheet(), oldW=sh.cols, oldD=sh.cells.D2; sh.cols={...(sh.cols||{}),D:45}; sh.cells.D2='아주 긴 글이 좁은 열을 넓히면 선택 상자와 칸이 어긋난다'; X.renderAll(); X.selectCell(1,4); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const b=document.querySelector('#curBox').getBoundingClientRect(), td=document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="1"][data-c="4"]').getBoundingClientRect(), th=document.querySelector('#grid th[data-col="3"]').getBoundingClientRect(); const res={box:Math.round(b.left),td:Math.round(td.left),dW:Math.round(th.width)}; if(oldW) sh.cols=oldW; else delete sh.cols; if(oldD===undefined) delete sh.cells.D2; else sh.cells.D2=oldD; X.renderAll(); return Math.abs(b.left+1-td.left)<=2 && Math.abs(th.width-45)<=2 ? true : JSON.stringify(res)

steps.name: 첨부 미리보기 - 요청 칸에 그림을 붙여넣으면 축소판, 축소판을 누르면 라이트박스, ✕ 는 미리보기 없이 빼기
steps.js: const ta=document.querySelector('#reqText'); const bin=atob('iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mP8z8DwHwAFBQIAX8jx0gAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=='); const u=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i); const dt=new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(new File([u],'image.png',{type:'image/png'})); ta.focus(); ta.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent('paste',{clipboardData:dt,bubbles:true,cancelable:true})); const img=await until(()=>document.querySelector('#reqAtt .a img'),5000); if(!img) return 'no thumb: '+document.querySelector('#reqAtt').innerHTML.slice(0,200); img.click(); const lb=await until(()=>{const x=document.querySelector('.nx-lb'); return x&&x.style.display!=='none'&&x.querySelector('.stage img')?x:null},3000); const shown=!!lb; if(lb) lb.querySelector('.x').click(); document.querySelector('#reqAtt [data-attx]').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const lb2=document.querySelector('.nx-lb'); return shown && !document.querySelector('#reqAtt .a img') && (!lb2||lb2.style.display==='none') ? true : JSON.stringify({shown,left:document.querySelectorAll('#reqAtt .a').length})

steps.name: HYPERLINK 이동 - 그냥 누르면 그 칸을 고르고, Ctrl+클릭은 "#C9"(이 탭)·"#'탭'!B4:C5"(탭 이름·범위)로 옮겨 고른다
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, X=N.x, S=N.S, sh=X.sheet(), old=[sh.cells.A20, sh.cells.A21]; sh.cells.A20={f:'=HYPERLINK("#C9","가기")'}; sh.cells.A21={f:"=HYPERLINK(\"#'"+sh.name+"'!B4:C5\",\"범위\")"}; N.recalc(); X.renderAll(); const td=(r)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="0"]'); const down=(r,ctrl)=>td(r).dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,ctrlKey:ctrl})); const up=()=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true})); const res={}; res.title=td(19).title; down(19,false); up(); res.plain=[S.cur.r,S.cur.c]; down(19,true); up(); res.jump=[S.cur.r,S.cur.c]; down(20,true); up(); res.range=[S.sel.r1,S.sel.c1,S.sel.r2,S.sel.c2]; ['A20','A21'].forEach((k,i)=>{ if(old[i]===undefined) delete sh.cells[k]; else sh.cells[k]=old[i]; }); N.recalc(); X.renderAll(); return res.title==='Ctrl+클릭 = 링크로 이동' && res.plain+''==='19,0' && res.jump+''==='8,2' && res.range+''==='3,1,4,2' ? true : JSON.stringify(res)

steps.name: 틀 고정 선택 표시 - C4 고정 뒤 B2:E31 을 고르고 아래로 스크롤하면 고정 행 쪽 상자는 B2 칸을 따라가고, 스크롤 쪽 상자는 고정 행 밑으로 가려진다(사분면 4개)
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, X=N.x, sh=X.sheet(), W=document.querySelector('#gridWrap'), oldF=sh.freeze; sh.freeze='C4'; X.renderAll(); X.selectRange({r1:1,c1:1,r2:30,c2:4}); W.scrollTop=0; W.scrollTop=200; W.dispatchEvent(new Event('scroll')); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,120)); const td=(r,c)=>document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="'+r+'"][data-c="'+c+'"]').getBoundingClientRect(); const base=document.querySelector('#selBox').getBoundingClientRect(), qs=[...document.querySelectorAll('.q-selBox')].filter(e=>!e.hidden), main=qs[qs.length-1], mr=main.getBoundingClientRect(), t=parseFloat((/inset\(([\d.]+)px/.exec(main.style.clipPath)||[0,0])[1]); const res={n:qs.length+1, baseTop:Math.round(base.top), b2:Math.round(td(1,1).top), visTop:Math.round(mr.top+t), fzBottom:Math.round(td(2,2).bottom), st:W.scrollTop}; sh.freeze=oldF; if(oldF===undefined) delete sh.freeze; W.scrollTop=0; X.renderAll(); X.selectCell(0,0); return res.n===4 && res.st>0 && Math.abs(res.baseTop-res.b2)<=2 && res.visTop>=res.fzBottom-2 ? true : JSON.stringify(res)

steps.name: 엔진 변경 안내 - /api/version 의 engine 이 바뀌면 시트에도 '엔진이 바뀌었습니다 · 새로 고침' 막대(같으면 안 뜸), ✕ 로 닫힘
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, S=N.S, bar=document.querySelector('#engNotice'); const was=S.engine; const before=bar.classList.contains('show'); S.engine=S.engine||'e0'; await N.applyVersion({deck:S.version, engine:S.engine}); const same=!bar.classList.contains('show'); await N.applyVersion({deck:S.version, engine:'바뀐엔진'}); const shown=bar.classList.contains('show') && /엔진/.test(bar.textContent); document.querySelector('#engClose').click(); const closed=!bar.classList.contains('show'); return !before && same && shown && closed ? true : JSON.stringify({before,same,shown,closed})

steps.name: VBA 실행기 - 표준 모듈 Function 을 칸에서 계산(=Twice(21) → 42), 아직 없는 함수 칸은 엑셀 값 그대로, { } VBA 단추가 보인다
steps.js: const S=window.NexaSheet.S, c=S.deck.sheets[0].cells; const btn=document.querySelector('#vbaBtn'); return c.A1.v===42 && c.A2.v==='엑셀 값' && btn && !btn.hidden ? true : JSON.stringify({a1:c.A1.v,a2:c.A2.v,btn:btn&&!btn.hidden})

steps.name: VBA 코드 창 - Twice 를 x*3 으로, 새 함수 Later 를 더해 적용 → 63·'L1', 문서 macros.modules 에 저장 · 못 쓰는 문법(With)은 아래에 경고
steps.js:
const N=window.NexaSheet, S=N.S; N.vbaOpen(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,80)); const dlg=document.querySelector('#vbaDlg'); const open=dlg.classList.contains('show'); const ta=document.querySelector('#vbaCode'); ta.value=ta.value.replace('x * 2','x * 3')+'Function Later(n)
    Later = "L" & n
End Function
Function Odd()
    With Application
    End With
End Function
'; ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input')); document.querySelector('#vbaApply').click(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,700)); const c=S.deck.sheets[0].cells, saved=S.deck.macros.modules[0].code.includes('x * 3'), warn=/With/.test(document.querySelector('#vbaMsgs').textContent); document.querySelector('#vbaClose').click(); const closed=!dlg.classList.contains('show'); return open && c.A1.v===63 && c.A2.v==='L1' && saved && warn && closed ? true : JSON.stringify({open,a1:c.A1.v,a2:c.A2.v,saved,warn,closed})

steps.name: 그림 고르기 - 그림을 누르면 고름(대상 '그림 t'), Shift 로 둘째(대상 '외 1'), 요청을 보내면 elements 에 그림 id 2개, 칸을 누르면 풀림
steps.js: const N=window.NexaSheet, S=N.S, w=(n)=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,n)); const ims=[...document.querySelectorAll('#draws img.drw')]; if(ims.length!==2) return 'imgs '+ims.length; const down=(el,o)=>el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,button:0,...(o||{})})); const up=()=>window.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',{bubbles:true})); down(ims[0]); up(); await w(40); const one=[...(S.drawSel||[])].join(','), t1=document.querySelector('#reqTarget').textContent, on1=ims[0].classList.contains('on'); down(ims[1],{shiftKey:true}); up(); await w(40); const two=[...(S.drawSel||[])].join(','), t2=document.querySelector('#reqTarget').textContent; const ta=document.querySelector('#reqText'); ta.value='그림 둘 크기 맞추기'; document.querySelector('#reqSend').click(); const q=await until(()=>S.reqs.find(r=>r.text==='그림 둘 크기 맞추기'),4000); const els=q&&q.elements?q.elements.join(','):null, rg=q?q.range:'-'; const td=document.querySelector('#grid td[data-r="5"][data-c="1"]'); down(td); up(); await w(40); const cleared=!S.drawSel && !document.querySelector('#draws img.drw.on'); return one==='t' && /그림 t$/.test(t1) && on1 && two==='t,logo2' && /그림 t 외 1/.test(t2) && els==='t,logo2' && rg===undefined && cleared ? true : JSON.stringify({one,t1,on1,two,t2,els,rg,cleared})
